summary: Iteration 33 - Major application overhaul testing. All 15 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed. Navigation overhaul with collapsible sections working. Campus switcher for admin/ED users working. Data isolation rules updated. /boards route works. Calendar year navigation visible. Admin-only pages (Financial APIs, PBX Settings) accessible. Main location renamed to '58:12 Global (Central)'. Default password 'User@58:12' confirmed.

minor.issue: Events sorted by status ASC puts 'completed' before 'upcoming' alphabetically. Should be status DESC to show upcoming first.

action_items: Consider changing events sorting from status ASC to status DESC to show upcoming events before completed events
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 33 features verified: (1) Navigation overhaul with collapsible sections (Ministry, Operations, Comms, Finance, Analytics, Admin) - all working with chevron indicators and auto-expand on active route. (2) Campus switcher in sidebar for admin/ED users - shows 'All Locations' dropdown with campuses, calls PUT /api/user/active-campus to filter data. (3) Data isolation - SYSTEM_ADMIN_ROLES now only admin/system_admin/ED. Directors and Advisers are campus-scoped. (4) /boards route works - renders TasksPage. (5) Calendar year navigation buttons (2025, 2026, 2027) visible. (6) Default password 'User@58:12' for new users via admin. (7) App name '58:12 Connect' in global settings. (8) Main location renamed to '58:12 Global (Central)'. (9) Admin-only Financial APIs and PBX Settings pages accessible. (10) Edit dialog has 4 tabs (Profile, Account, Flags, Documents).

navigation_overhaul.details: Collapsible sections with chevron indicators. Sections: Ministry (Outreach, Events, Check-ins), Operations (Boards, Resources, Calendar, People, Scheduling, Access), Comms (Chat, History), Finance (Financial, Sales), Analytics (Attendance, Sales Analytics, Location Stats, Advanced Analytics, Reports, Report Builder), Admin (Staff Management, Campuses, Financial APIs, PBX, Email Templates, Settings, Audit, GDPR). Auto-expand on active route working.

campus_switcher.details: Dropdown in sidebar shows 'All Locations' with campuses: 58:12 Global (Central), 58:12 Haiti, 58:12 Kenya, 58:12 Rescue, 58:12 Uganda, 58:12 United. Calls PUT /api/user/active-campus to set filter. PUT /api/user/active-campus/clear to show all data.

data_isolation.details: SYSTEM_ADMIN_ROLES in deps.py updated to only admin/system_admin/Executive Director. get_campus_filter checks active_campus_id for admin campus switcher. Non-admin roles scoped to their campus.

boards_route.details: /boards route renders TasksPage. Nav shows 'Boards' under Operations section.

events_ordering.details: Events sorted by status ASC then date ASC. This puts 'completed' before 'upcoming' alphabetically. Minor issue - should be status DESC for upcoming first.

calendar_year_navigation.details: Year navigation buttons (2025, 2026, 2027) visible in calendar header. Clicking changes year.

default_password.details: New users created via admin get default password 'User@58:12'. Confirmed via API test.

app_name.details: Global settings default app_name is '58:12 Connect'.

main_location_name.details: Main location renamed to '58:12 Global (Central)'. Visible in locations page and campus switcher.

admin_only_pages.details: Financial APIs page (/financial-apis) and PBX Settings page (/pbx-settings) accessible to admin. Nav shows these under Admin section.

edit_dialog_tabs.details: Edit profile dialog has 4 tabs: Profile, Account, Flags, Documents.

login_flow.details: Login with admin@5812uganda.org / Admin@5812 working correctly.
